Rule pack — date and time consistency

Source: R/rules_dates.R
make_rule_pack_dates.Rd

Builds executable FlagRule objects for the date and time integrity checks from the core observability rule catalog.

Usage

make_rule_pack_dates(
  domain,
  key_vars,
  subject_var = "USUBJID",
  group_var = "SITEID",
  start_end_pairs = list(),
  date_vars = character(),
  time_date_pairs = list(),
  visit_order_var = NULL,
  study_start = NULL,
  study_end = NULL,
  cutoff_date = Sys.Date(),
  owner_team = "DM",
  ...
)

Arguments

domain

Domain name targeted by the rules.

key_vars

Character vector of key variables.

subject_var

Subject identifier variable. Default "USUBJID".

group_var

Group identifier variable. Default "SITEID".

start_end_pairs

List of two-element character vectors naming a start/end date pair, e.g. list(c("AESTDTC", "AEENDTC")).

date_vars

Character vector of variables expected to hold full ISO 8601 dates (YYYY-MM-DD).

time_date_pairs

List of two-element character vectors c(time_var, date_var) where the time variable should not be present when the corresponding date variable is missing.

visit_order_var

Optional numeric variable used to order visits within a subject (e.g. "VISITNUM" or "ADY").

study_start

Optional Date or ISO string. Events before this date are flagged by R012.

study_end

Optional Date or ISO string. Events after this date are flagged by R012.

cutoff_date

Date used as "today" for the future-dating check (R018). Defaults to Sys.Date().

owner_team

Team assigned to follow up on flagged records.

...

Reserved for future extensions; currently ignored.

Value

A list of FlagRule objects compatible with run_flags().

Details

Rule IDNameScope
R011Start date after end dateRecord
R012Event date outside study periodRecord
R013Invalid or partial date formatRecord
R014End date present but start missingRecord
R015Time present without dateRecord
R016Visit dates out of order within subjectGroup
R017Identical timestamps across multiple recordsGroup
R018Future-dated eventsRecord

Examples

pack <- make_rule_pack_dates(
  domain          = "LB",
  key_vars        = c("STUDYID", "USUBJID", "LBSEQ"),
  date_vars       = "LBDTC",
  visit_order_var = "VISITNUM"
)
length(pack)
#> [1] 4
